def separate_even_odd(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    
    # Initialize two pointers: left and right
    left = 0
    right = n-1 
    
    # Check if starting number is even and ending number is odd
    if arr[left] % 2 == 0 and arr[right] % 2 != 0:
        # Rearrange the numbers such that all even numbers are before odd numbers
        while left < right:
            # Increment left pointer until it points to an even number
            while left < right and arr[left] % 2 == 0:
                left += 1
            
            # Count right pointer until it points to an odd number
            while left < right and arr[right] % 2 != 0:
                right -= 1
                
            # Swap elements at left and right
            arr[left], arr[right] = arr[right], arr[left]
            
        return True
    
    return False
